subject: Mathematics
title: Completing a square
prompt: Explain geometrically why x² + 2x + 1 = (x + 1)², using a square, two strips, and a missing corner.
learner: Knows rectangle area and simple algebra.
styleBrief: Geometric construction: colored area pieces move into place; symbolic labels stay attached.
criteria: The two strips each have area x, and the corner has area 1.
The completed square has side x + 1.
Movement should preserve each piece's size.
